summary: Organizer app with voice features and a built-in messenger for sending reminders, with no login (shared access for everyone).
architectural_notes: No authentication/login: app operates in a public/shared mode accessible to all users.

existing_features.title: Create an organizer app that lets an authenticated user create, view, edit, and delete reminders with a title, optional notes, due date/time, and completion status.
Add voice features so users can dictate reminder content and message text using in-browser speech-to-text, and optionally read a reminder aloud using text-to-speech.
Implement an in-app messenger where authenticated users can send and receive messages, including the ability to send a reminder as a message.
Provide reminder notifications inside the app by showing a prominent 'Due now' section and triggering an in-app alert when a reminder becomes due (while the app is open).
Design and implement a coherent visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and layout) for the organizer + messenger app and apply it consistently across all screens.
Generate required static images and render them in the UI from frontend/public/assets/generated (no backend image serving).
Update the React app so it does not require Internet Identity login to use the reminders and messaging features; the main app UI must be accessible immediately on load.
Remove or disable all login/logout and first-time profile setup UI flows (including the login button and profile setup dialog) so the interface reflects a shared/public mode.
Adjust messaging and “send reminder as message” UX to work in shared/public mode without requiring users to enter Principal IDs.

new_feature_requests.summary: Build an organizer app with voice capability and an in-app messenger to send reminders.
Remove authentication/login and make the app usable by everyone without signing in (shared/public access).
Change backend authorization logic so anonymous (unauthenticated) callers can create, read, update, and delete reminders, and can send/read/delete messages without receiving authorization traps.
